dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures on the mid-posterior dorsal region. Perimeters consist of thin, dark-pixel boundaries with a sharp gradient transition to high-intensity light centers. Geometries range from near-perfect circles to elongated ellipses with irregular, non-uniform edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of solid high-intensity light-colored clusters situated primarily along the lower lateral margin. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as irregular, localized concentrations of light pixels against the dark fur substrate.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Spatial centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an elongated scalene triangle. The posterior-most ring centroid is positioned at an approximate 45-degree angle relative to the mid-dorsal ring centroid when measured from the spinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense interlocking of multiple small ring structures on the upper posterior quadrant, creating a localized honeycomb-like texture topology.
